what: ExxonMobil finds and pumps oil and natural gas, refines it into fuels, and makes chemicals and lubricants. Its biggest growth areas are the Permian Basin in the US and offshore Guyana.
customers: Refiners, fuel distributors, airlines, chemical buyers and drivers at Exxon and Mobil stations.
money: producing crude oil and natural gas
refining and selling gasoline, diesel and jet fuel
moat: Huge low-cost reserves, integrated refining and chemicals that soften oil-price swings, and one of the strongest balance sheets in energy.
risks: Long-term shift away from fossil fuels
